The '''Erselu''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of wild and fierce predators native to the [[Steepara tree|steepara]] forests of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dressel/Legends|Dressel]], where they posed a constant threat to the [[Dressellese]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] species. They were similar in some way to the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] species of the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]].<ref name="SOT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Erselu were first mentioned in [[Stay on Target (sourcebook)|''Stay on Target'']], a supplement released in [[2015]] by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion (roleplaying game)|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'']] roleplaying game.
